lead.claim: For refractory plantar fasciopathy, exercise is not inferior to microtenotomy.
lead.context: Why this matters: *This randomized controlled trial compared radiofrequency microtenotomy with heavy-slow resistance training for pain in refractory plantar fasciopathy.*

supporting.claim: Children with limb loss after trauma may need emotional support.
supporting.context: Why this matters: *This retrospective analysis examined the physical and psychosocial outcomes in children with earthquake-related limb loss two years post-amputation.*

supporting.claim: Can assessing a patient's self-correction ability predict scoliosis outcomes?
supporting.context: Why this matters: *This prospective study quantified active self-correction during physiotherapeutic scoliosis-specific exercises and its association with Cobb angle change.*

supporting.claim: Adding hip-ankle training after TKA offers only modest, short-term benefits.
supporting.context: Why this matters: *This randomized controlled trial investigated the effect of multi-joint lower-limb training on function after total knee arthroplasty.*

supporting.claim: Malnutrition is common and linked to frailty in older diabetic outpatients.
supporting.context: Why this matters: *This retrospective study examined the prevalence of GLIM-defined malnutrition and its association with frailty in older outpatients with diabetes.*
